title: Power Outage Indicator
shortDescription: The refrigerator detected a power interruption.
fullDescription: PO indicates a power outage occurred. Press any key to clear. Check food safety — freezer contents above 40F for over 2 hours should be discarded. KitchenAid fridges preserve setpoints but log the outage event.

fixSteps.title: Clear
fixSteps.instruction: Press any pad to dismiss PO.

videoSearchQuery: KitchenAid refrigerator PO power outage clear

faq.a: No — it's an informational alert about a past outage.

title: Ice Maker Optics Error
fullDescription:
rF indicates the ice-level optical sensor in the ice maker cannot communicate or is blocked. The optics are a pair of IR emitter/receiver that sense ice bin level.

Clean the optics lenses and clear any ice blocking the beam. Persistent rF requires optics board replacement.

fixSteps.title: Empty and clean
fixSteps.instruction: Remove ice bin, wipe optic lenses on each side of freezer wall.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Turn ice maker off/on via control.

whenToCallPro: If ice maker assembly needs extensive disassembly.
videoSearchQuery: KitchenAid refrigerator rF ice maker optics fix

faq.a: Two small lenses on either side of the freezer wall near the ice bin.

title: Ice Maker Sensor Error
fullDescription:
IS indicates the ice maker mold temperature sensor is out of range. This sensor tells the control when ice is frozen enough to harvest.

The sensor is built into the ice maker module. Replacement typically requires a new ice maker assembly.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Check ice maker plug is fully seated.

whenToCallPro: If comfortable working inside freezer, DIY-friendly.
videoSearchQuery: KitchenAid refrigerator IS ice maker sensor fix

faq.a: No — it protects against ejector jam. Replace the full module.

title: Defrost System Error
fullDescription:
dE indicates the evaporator temperature did not rise during a defrost cycle. Defrost heater or bimetal terminator typically open. Thick frost on the evaporator accompanies this fault.

Defrost unit overnight before servicing, then test heater continuity.
whenToCallPro: If main control relay is at fault.

faq.a: Adaptive defrost roughly every 8-14 compressor-run hours.

title: Display Test or Stuck
shortDescription: All segments lit — test pattern or failure.
fullDescription:
88 with all segments lit is a normal self-test at power-up. If persistent beyond a few seconds, the display board has failed.

Replace display module if stuck.

faq.a: No — brief 88 at startup is normal.

title: Freezer Fan Error
shortDescription: The freezer evaporator fan has stalled.
fullDescription: FF indicates the evaporator fan motor is not rotating at expected speed. Ice buildup on the blade or a failed motor are typical causes. The fresh food compartment warms quickly without this fan since air is circulated through it from the freezer.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fan
fixSteps.instruction: Access through evaporator cover; check blade freedom.

videoSearchQuery: KitchenAid refrigerator FF fan error fix

faq.q: Why is fresh food warm but freezer cold?
faq.a: Air is cooled in the freezer and pushed to fresh food; without fan, only freezer stays cold.

title: Evaporator Fan Communication
shortDescription: Evaporator fan motor not responding to control commands.
fullDescription:
SY EF is a system fault specifically indicating the evaporator fan (BLDC motor with feedback) isn't reporting speed to the control. The newer ECM fans communicate RPM; loss of feedback triggers SY EF.

Check harness and replace fan if needed.
videoSearchQuery: KitchenAid refrigerator SY EF fan fix

faq.a: Evaporator Fan — SY indicates a system/communication error.

title: Control Board Communication Error
fullDescription: SY CE indicates the main control and user interface are not communicating. Power cycle first; if persistent, reseat the communication harness and replace boards as needed.
whenToCallPro: Board diagnosis is tricky — pro recommended.
videoSearchQuery: KitchenAid refrigerator SY CE communication fix

faq.a: Usually no — cooling continues on last setpoint.

title: Generic Error Indicator
shortDescription: Generic error requiring diagnostic mode for details.
fullDescription:
ER alone is a generic error. Enter service/diagnostic mode (press and hold Lock + Measured Fill for 3 seconds on most KitchenAid models) to retrieve the specific fault code from memory.

Follow the revealed specific code's procedure.

causes.cause: Various — requires diagnostic mode to identify

fixSteps.title: Enter diagnostic
fixSteps.instruction: Press Lock + Measured Fill for 3 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Read code
fixSteps.instruction: Specific code appears; follow its procedure.

whenToCallPro: After specific error identified, if complex.

faq.a: Press Lock + Measured Fill simultaneously for 3 seconds on most models.

title: Heater Error
fullDescription: HE indicates the defrost heater drew unexpected current or no current when energized. Test heater with multimeter; replace if open or shorted.
whenToCallPro: If coil must be removed for access.

faq.q: Can I run fridge with HE?
faq.a: Short-term yes, but frost buildup reduces cooling quickly.

title: Control Lock Active
fullDescription: LOC indicates the child lock or control lock feature is active. This prevents accidental setpoint changes. Press and hold the Lock pad for 3 seconds to deactivate.

fixSteps.title: Unlock
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold Lock for 3 seconds.

faq.a: Some models auto-lock after 1 minute of inactivity; check settings.

title: Condenser Fan Error
shortDescription: The condenser fan motor has stalled or failed.
fullDescription: CF indicates the condenser fan beneath the refrigerator is not running. This causes the compressor to overheat. Clean debris from blade; replace motor if seized.

fixSteps.title: Clean coils
fixSteps.instruction: Pull unit, vacuum condenser and fan area.

fixSteps.title: Test motor
fixSteps.instruction: Spin blade; replace if stiff or noisy.

whenToCallPro: Only if unit is difficult to pull out.
videoSearchQuery: KitchenAid refrigerator CF condenser fan fix

faq.q: How often should I clean condenser?

title: Power Outage KitchenAid
shortDescription: Power was off long enough to log alarm.
fullDescription: PO-K is the power-outage flag on KitchenAid units; it alerts the user that food may have warmed during the outage.

fixSteps.title: Verify temps

faq.a: Use a thermometer; do not rely on smell.
